description: Return the same key figures as get_financials for each of a Danish company's latest annual reports, one row per reporting year, newest first. Use it for trends and growth; use get_financials when one year (with its previous-year comparison and auditor) is enough. Reads one filing per year, so it is slower than get_financials. A corrected report replaces the original; years without a machine-readable report are skipped.

cvr.description: Danish CVR number, 8 digits (spaces, dashes and a DK prefix are accepted), e.g. "24256790".

scope.description: For group reports (koncernregnskab): "group" = the consolidated group, "parent" = the parent company alone. Ignored for single companies.

years.description: How many reporting years to return, counting back from the latest.

name: get_financials_history

years.description: Newest first; empty when the company has no machine-readable annual reports.

figures.description: Key figure → value for that year (revenue, profit, equity, …); null when not reported.

notes.description: Gaps, conflicts and caveats found in the filing, in plain English.

scope.description: Whose figures these are; "company" for a report without a group.

source.description: The filing document the figures were read from.

title: Get key financials over several years
